utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help load up tools or haul scraps. Just tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If you can start with the scrap pile by the shed, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: On it — I’ll start at the scrap pile by the shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to confirm the timing and what kind of repairs are included first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds right to me — can you confirm the timing and which repairs are actually included?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — I’d like the exact schedule and a clear list of included repairs before I commit. Then I can check whether I can help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed a detail or two, but I’m listening now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, no worries—I’m probably mixing up a detail or two myself. I just meant we’re gathering whatever people can spare for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—so it’s just a grab-what-you-can kind of thing. I can bring something by soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to bring a few tools by and help out for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s really kind of you, Vik. I’ll let the others know you’re coming by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks. I’ll swing by with the tools and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — it’s going pretty well. I’ve got a few tools out if you need anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — I might take you up on that. What do you still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like a clear plan—when is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday morning at the community center—just bring any tools you’re comfortable lending, plus gloves if you have them. I’ll send the full list around so nobody has to guess.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I'll bring my gloves and a couple of tools. Please send the full list when you can so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great—if you could bring a few gloves and some trash bags, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll bring a few gloves and some trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what part do you want to figure out first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with where the repair drive will be held and who we’re meeting there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Let’s keep it simple: we can meet at the community center parking lot, since there’s room for tools and folks to gather. If that works, I can help spread the word to both groups.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m in for the repair drive and happy to help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara — thank you. I’ll put you down to help, and I’ll send over the next steps soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Hana — we’re starting in the afternoon and can use help sorting donations. If you can, bring gloves and a box cutter, but otherwise just bring yourself.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d help a lot—just let me know what’s missing, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a quick inventory and tell you what’s missing as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is still on for this weekend—folks are dropping off tools and spare parts by the community center. I can swing by later and tell you if they need any more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess—that’d be great. I can help if they still need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check in this afternoon and let you know if they want another helper. If they do, I’ll save you a spot!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first—what needs fixing and by when?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can send the repair drive details now. It’s mainly for the school items that need fixing, and I’ll share the deadline in just a moment.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — I appreciate it. I’ll send the time and place as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll take a quick look and see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll swing by after I finish these errands and check in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just swing by when you can and I’ll see where I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll swing by the repair drive and repeat the plan to folks nearby so everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’ll really help keep everyone coordinated. I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll keep it simple and make sure folks hear the plan clearly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, so what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I just need help getting the broken stuff over there and maybe a hand sorting it out once we arrive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can do that. Just point me to what needs moving, and I’ll help sort it once we get there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly tools and a few extra hands—wrenches, screwdrivers, a drill if you’ve got one. If you can swing by, we could use you too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring a screwdriver and maybe a wrench, and I’ll stop by to help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to bring their items.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, I’ll wait for the details and deadline before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll send you the details and deadline soon, and I’ll keep the drop-off info clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mina — that works. If I find anything tricky, I’ll set it aside and let you know what needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — just let me know the timing and where to drop things off, and I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening today—can you remind me what time we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — we’re still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, as long as we keep it simple and know the plan. Tell me what needs fixing and when you want to do it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I think we should keep it simple and start with the easiest fixes first. I’ll send you the list and we can pick a time that works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane. Send the list over, and once I’ve looked it through, we can set a time that fits my routine.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering tools and spare parts, and I’m keeping a list of what’s running low. If you hear of anyone with extra screws, tape, or a drill, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that—I'll pass along any extra screws, tape, or a drill if I hear about them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring my tool box, but I forgot it again. Tell me where you need a hand, and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Oren — I can use help sorting the donations and setting up the tables. If you can swing by the hall in about twenty minutes, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Twenty minutes, got it — I’ll be there with a clear head this time, hopefully. I’ll help sort the donations and set up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — I was thinking 3:30 to 5:00 after school.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work—I can plan around pickup and let the other parents know.
